description:
Search the surplus funds (excess proceeds) still on an official list: money left after a tax deed or
        foreclosure sale that the former owner or lienholders can claim. `state`: two-letter code or name;
        `county`: optional county name (e.g. "Duval"); `min_amount`: optional floor in dollars; `sort`: amount_desc,
        amount_asc, deadline_asc, deadline_desc or sale_date_desc; `page_number` from 1, `per_page` 1 to 100.

        Each row: case or certificate number, parcel id, property address, former owner (people as initials, businesses
        as recorded), sale type and date, amount as published, claim deadline and its basis, and the official list URL.
        Amounts are as the office published them; claims, deadlines and eligibility are decided by that office (the
        county page and surplus_funds_summary give the statute and how to claim). list_coverage lists covered counties.
name: surplus_funds_search
